Resolution tracker

Markets tracked until they resolved

The requirement is to follow an event until the exchange says how it ended. Kalshi sets result to yes, no or scalar when a market is determined and status to finalized once positions are paid (market lifecycle). The table below is built only from markets that reached that state; the settlement value and timestamp are the API's own fields.

Still open, being tracked

Open markets are polled on the dashboard until they leave active. When one resolves it moves into the table above with the API's own result.

No guessing. A market whose result is empty is never displayed as "no" — it stays open until the exchange publishes an outcome. Scalar markets would be shown with their settlement value, and none were captured for these five topics.
